title: Guard a service with an access control proxy
description: AdminService exposes sensitive operations. SecureServiceProxy wraps it and enforces three access tiers: ADMIN gets full access, USER gets read-only access (getData only), and any other role is blocked entirely. Implement SecureServiceProxy so it enforces these rules without modifying AdminService.
hints: SecureServiceProxy implements the same Service interface as AdminService
Store the caller's role in the proxy and check it per method — different methods allow different roles
getData() should pass for both ADMIN and USER; deleteAll() should pass for ADMIN only
Throw UnauthorizedException (provided) when the role is not permitted for that method
issues: Without a proxy, access control must be duplicated inside every service method or at every call site
AdminService itself cannot change its public interface to add security without breaking callers
overallGoal: Use the Protection Proxy pattern to enforce role-based access control transparently, keeping AdminService itself free of security logic.
goals: ADMIN callers can invoke both getData() and deleteAll()
USER callers can invoke getData() but receive UnauthorizedException on deleteAll()
Any other role receives UnauthorizedException on all methods without the real service being called
